data.name: App.AccessControl.AdminRolesDescription
data.value: Full access to every namespace, including namespace create/delete. Set with {0} and not editable here - it is the bootstrap that lets somebody sign in and grant everyone else their access.

data.value: Who can do what in each existing namespace - the union of the grants scoped to it and the grants that apply to all namespaces, the same resolution the access checks themselves use. Admins always have full access and are not listed here. This page is read-only: grants are managed one namespace at a time, under Configure access on the Namespaces page.
